title: New developer idea: Mechborne Origins
author: Dr-BBq
selftext: first time trying to design a game, not a promise, just scoping. Mechborne Origins. Genre: single player survival mech RPG with optional co-op later. Survival hooks are fuel, oxygen, and hunger only when it makes sense. Tone is scrappy survival with room for earned hope, not grimdark, just tough logistics and people helping each other. You start in the family barn with Old Bessie, a retrofitted farm rig. First hours are hauling, repairs, and careful fuel juggling. Side grades are Hap AGR-1, a fragile scout, and Barnjack Four, a loud loader. Story hook: strange beacons and quiet derelicts pull you outward. You rebuild a wrecked shuttle before you ever reach the stars. I’m keeping scope small and learning in public. I plan to get the new Cursor plan and unreal engine. I have an upgraded GPT account. Any tips or things to steer clear of? Thanks in advance!
